## Names

<a id="file_range_bitmap"></a>
### [`file_range_bitmap`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L6) `$32EF`

*routine*

Sets the KERNAL start address (STAL $c1/$c2) to $6000 and the end address (EAL $ae/$af) to $7f40: the 8000 bitmap bytes.

- **Called from:** [`save_picture`](picture_file.md#save_picture) [`$3313`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L29), [`load_picture`](picture_file.md#load_picture) [`$3368`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L74)
- **Writes:** [`STAL`](../../memory-map.md#STAL), [`STAL+1`](../../memory-map.md#STAL), [`EAL`](../../memory-map.md#EAL), [`EAL+1`](../../memory-map.md#EAL)

<a id="file_range_colours"></a>
### [`file_range_colours`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L17) `$3300`

*routine*

Sets STAL to $c000 and EAL to $c7d1: the screen colours, the colour RAM and the background colour (2001 bytes). Then copies STAL to the KERNAL pointer $ac/$ad ($fb8e).

- **Called from:** [`save_picture`](picture_file.md#save_picture) [`$3341`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L49), [`load_picture`](picture_file.md#load_picture) [`$339C`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L98)
- **Jumps to:** `$FB8E`
- **Writes:** [`STAL`](../../memory-map.md#STAL), [`STAL+1`](../../memory-map.md#STAL), [`EAL`](../../memory-map.md#EAL), [`EAL+1`](../../memory-map.md#EAL)

<a id="save_picture"></a>
### [`save_picture`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L28) `$3313`

*routine*

Saves the picture as a Koala file with the file name and device that are set. Opens the file with secondary address 1 ($f3d5) and checks the drive status ($2d0f, then drive_status); on an error it jumps to $2beb. Then sends the load address $6000, the bitmap $6000-$7f3f and $c000-$c7d0, and closes the file ($f63f). The STOP key ends the save with C set.

- **Called from:** [`storage_screen`](storage_screen.md#storage_screen) [`$2BC7`](../../../../src/storage/storage_screen.asm#L279)
- **Calls:** [`file_range_bitmap`](picture_file.md#file_range_bitmap), `$F3D5`, [`check_drive_status`](storage_screen.md#check_drive_status), `$ED0C`, `$EDB9`, `$FB8E`, `$EDDD`, [`save_send_bytes`](picture_file.md#save_send_bytes), [`file_range_colours`](picture_file.md#file_range_colours)
- **Jumps to:** [`storage_transfer_abort`](storage_screen.md#storage_transfer_abort), `$F63F`
- **Reads:** [`FA`](../../memory-map.md#FA), [`SA`](../../memory-map.md#SA), `$00AC`, `$00AD`
- **Writes:** [`SA`](../../memory-map.md#SA)

<a id="save_send_bytes"></a>
### [`save_send_bytes`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L53) `$334A`

*routine*

Sends the bytes from $ac/$ad up to EAL with CIOUT. The STOP key closes the file ($f642), drops the return address and returns from the caller with A = 0 and C set.
C set when $ac/$ad has reached EAL.

- **Called from:** [`save_picture`](picture_file.md#save_picture) [`$333E`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L48), [`save_picture`](picture_file.md#save_picture) [`$3344`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L50)
- **Calls:** `$FCD1`, `$EDDD`, [`STOP`](../../memory-map.md#STOP), `$F642`, `$FCDB`
- **Reads:** `$00AC`

<a id="load_picture"></a>
### [`load_picture`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L73) `$3368`

*routine*

Loads a Koala file with the file name and device that are set. Opens the file with secondary address 0 ($f3d5) and checks the drive status ($2d0f, then drive_status); on an error it jumps to $2beb. The file's load address is not used: the first 8000 bytes go to the bitmap $6000-$7f3f, the next 2001 bytes to $c000-$c7d0. A read timeout on the first byte gives FILE NOT FOUND ($f704).

- **Called from:** [`storage_screen`](storage_screen.md#storage_screen) [`$2BE3`](../../../../src/storage/storage_screen.asm#L296)
- **Calls:** [`file_range_bitmap`](picture_file.md#file_range_bitmap), `$F3D5`, [`check_drive_status`](storage_screen.md#check_drive_status), `$ED09`, `$EDC7`, `$EE13`, `$FB8E`, [`load_read_bytes`](picture_file.md#load_read_bytes), [`file_range_colours`](picture_file.md#file_range_colours)
- **Jumps to:** [`storage_transfer_abort`](storage_screen.md#storage_transfer_abort), [`load_file_not_found`](picture_file.md#load_file_not_found), `$F528`
- **Reads:** [`FA`](../../memory-map.md#FA), [`SA`](../../memory-map.md#SA), [`STATUS`](../../memory-map.md#STATUS)
- **Writes:** [`STATUS`](../../memory-map.md#STATUS), [`SA`](../../memory-map.md#SA)

### [`load_read_bytes`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L102) `$33A5`

*routine*

Reads bytes with ACPTR to $ac/$ad up to EAL. After a read timeout (STATUS bit 1) it reads again. The STOP key drops the return address and jumps to $f633 in the KERNAL.

- **Called from:** [`load_picture`](picture_file.md#load_picture) [`$3399`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L97), [`load_picture`](picture_file.md#load_picture) [`$339F`](../../../../src/storage/picture_file.asm#L99)
- **Calls:** `$FCD1`, [`STOP`](../../memory-map.md#STOP), `$EE13`, `$FCDB`
- **Jumps to:** `$F633`, `$F704`
- **Reads:** [`STATUS`](../../memory-map.md#STATUS), `$00AC`
- **Writes:** [`STATUS`](../../memory-map.md#STATUS)
